text:
ana (People Ops): Quick update — please read 👇
ana (People Ops): We're temporarily pausing automatic mid‑year PTO allocations while we reconcile regional balances and align with the new travel per‑diem policy. This pause starts now and will last ~2 weeks.
devon: Is this for all regions or just EMEA/APAC?
ana (People Ops): All regions. Main reason: discrepancies we found between accruals and approved time-off after recent org moves. We need to fix the ledger before issuing more days.
sanjay (People Ops): To be clear: this does NOT cancel any already‑booked PTO. If you already have approved time off, your dates remain intact.
mike (eng): Phew, thanks. Any impact on travel reimbursements?
katie (finance): Short answer: no on previously approved expenses. For new travel bookings, note there's a revised per‑diem cap and an updated approval flow for higher‑risk countries.
travel-bot: New travel checklist published — https://intranet.redwood/travel-checklist (country advisories live).
devon: Where do managers submit exceptions?
sanjay (People Ops): Managers can request exceptions via the People Ops form: https://forms.redwood/ops-exception — choose "PTO/Travel exception" and attach justification. We'll review within 3 business days.
ana (People Ops): Expense code update for new per‑diems: use `TRV-2026` for meals/lodging under the new caps. Example for Concur upload: ```Expense Code: TRV-2026
Category: Meals
Limit: $60/day (USD)```
mike (eng): If I'm on a multi‑leg trip spanning different per‑diem zones, which cap applies?
katie (finance): Apply the cap for the country where the overnight stay occurs. If multiple nights in different countries, use per‑night country cap. We'll add an FAQ.
devon: Any compensation/top‑up for people who lost PTO from the earlier accrual bug?
ana (People Ops): Yes — reconciliation will include a top‑up for affected employees. We'll notify individuals next week with exact amounts and retro pay if applicable.
sanjay (People Ops): We're also running a short survey to collect edge cases — please fill if you have complex travel schedules or cross‑regional PTO: https://surveys.redwood/midyear-pto.
mike (eng): Timeline recap pls?
ana (People Ops): Recap: pause immediate, reconciliation in next 10 business days, top‑ups & exceptions processed within 15 business days, travel checklist live now.
devon: Thanks — appreciate the transparency.
ana (People Ops): We'll post a detailed reconciliation note and a small walkthrough (video + written) later today. If urgent issues, @sanjay or @ana available. :handshake:
